correct_answer: Director approval under Ridgeline's legacy policy — the transition notice was never issued, so the legacy policy still applies per the Integration Transition Addendum
rationale: The Integration Transition Addendum is explicit: acquired entity policies remain in effect 'until formal notification of policy transition.' The formal notification was never issued. Legal authorized HR to send it in September 2025, but the SharePoint transition-notices folder shows the last notice posted was in August 2025 (Benefits & Compensation) — the outside activities notice never made it out. The Teams message from Maria Santos in July 2025 confirms the legacy policy was still in effect at that time, and no subsequent evidence shows the transition was ever completed. Answer B applies reasonable-person logic but ignores the explicit contractual language of the Addendum — 'until formal notification' is unambiguous and doesn't include a sunset clause. Answer B fails because the request is being formally submitted NOW (June 2026), the verbal December 2024 conversation is undocumented, and even under Ridgeline's policy, board service requires Director approval (not just verbal mention). Answer D conflates authorization to issue with actual issuance — the Addendum requires 'formal notification,' not intent to notify. The absence of the document in SharePoint is the critical signal proving the notification never reached employees.
